newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-NINE-MAN BAYERN SALVAGE DERBY DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-NINE-MAN BAYERN SALVAGE DERBY DRAW.

text.p: Bayern Munich missed the chance to go five points clear at the top of the Bundesliga on Sunday, only salvaging a 3-3 draw with local rivals 1860 Munich thanks to a Carsten Jancker goal two minutes from time.

Bayern, reduced to nine men after wing back Christian Ziege and captain Lothar Matthaeus were sent off for second bookable offences in the second half, twice came from behind to get back on level terms.
1860, looking for their first win over Bayern since 1977, raced to a 2-0 lead with two goals from Horst Heldt.
But Juergen Klinsmann pulled one back for Bayern just before the break and Mehmet Scholl added a spectacular second early in the second half.

1860 looked to have the game sewn up when substitute Joerg Boehme put them 3-2 ahead with his first kick of the ball in the 82nd minute but Jancker's late strike meant they had to settle for a share of the points.
